generator.sphereworld.planet.info: Finite spherical planets stacked as concentric shells.
sphereworld.customize.title: Planet & Dimension Stacking
sphereworld.customize.hint: Top of the list is the outermost shell, bottom is the centre of the planet
sphereworld.customize.size.tooltip: Circumference of this planet in blocks: walk this far in a straight line and you are back where you started. Infinite keeps the vanilla flat world.
sphereworld.customize.size.unsupported: This dimension does not use noise terrain, so it cannot wrap around. It can still be stacked.
sphereworld.customize.stacked.tooltip: Stacked dimensions are nested shells: dig through the bottom to fall into the shell below, climb past the top to reach the shell above.
sphereworld.customize.open_boundaries.to: Replaces the bedrock floor and roof between stacked shells with the surrounding rock so you can dig straight through.
sphereworld.customize.single_layer: Stack at least two dimensions to travel between shells
sphereworld.customize.size.derived: Computed from the Overworld so the layers touch exactly, all at their vanilla height: the Nether's roof meets the Overworld's floor, the End rests on its build limit. Portals keep the vanilla 1:8 ratio.
sphereworld.customize.size.overworld: Circumference of the planet, from 2,048 to 65,536 blocks. Every dimension keeps its vanilla height (ores, caves and structures unchanged); the Nether and the End are sized to fit exactly, and the bedrock core grows with the planet.
sphereworld.customize.geometry.gap: Layers stacked with a gap between them
sphereworld.loading.voxy: Generating the whole planet for Voxy: %s / %s chunks (%s %%)
sphereworld.loading.voxy.skip: Escape: play now (the rest is generated next time)
